## What was checked

- [ ] Renders checked at phone and desktop width (or: no visible change)
- [ ] CI green: secret scan, large-file gate, and the repo's own checks
- [ ] Every claim traces to the repo's facts file (or: no site copy)
- [ ] Zero em dashes; no credentials; nothing private in a public repo
- [ ] Theme or plugin version moved forward only, with its changelog line (or: no version change)
- [ ] Docs current: decisions log, changelog, READMEs touched by this change

## After merge

Every step a person must do once this merges (the zip plus every step rule): uploads, plugin
updates, settings, setup re-run, permalink save, cache purges, and what to check afterwards.
Write "None" when there is nothing.
